settings.heading: Start here.
settings.text: You need three things. Here they are.

settings.title: Your own rod and reel
settings.text: We don't sell rods, so bring your own. A basic spinning rod and reel is the easiest to learn on, and any sporting goods store has one.

settings.title: A Ketto kit
settings.text: Hooks, weights, bait, and lures, already matched to the fish you're after. Nothing else to buy.

settings.title: A fishing license
settings.text: Most states require one. Check your state's fish and game website before you go.

settings.heading: Pick your kit.
settings.subheading: Each one has everything except the rod and reel.

settings.title: Set it up
settings.text: Scan the sticker in your kit. It walks you through rigging, step by step.

settings.title: Go early or late
settings.text: Fish bite best around sunrise and sunset. Cast near docks, logs, and weeds.

settings.title: Reel slow and steady
settings.text: When you feel a tug, keep reeling. That's it.
